comparisonMethod: Compare quoted passages word by word after normalising whitespace, mathematical font and ordinary plain-text rendering of indices. Explicit ellipses separate excerpts; they do not imply omitted hypotheses are absent. An omitted prose qualifier or a missing overbar is recorded, not silently normalised. Nonliteral inputs are not labelled preprint-only without a demonstrated version difference.
provenanceNote: The batch says readFrom=preprint, but the current input record reports published-version extraction and review, with journal-page locators. This session independently inspected the published copy. It did not read a preprint or establish a preprint-to-print revision.
mathematicalScope: Sentence collation only. Existing mathematical corrections, counterarguments, review verdicts and newness claims remain unchanged and are not independently certified. The recorded input-quotation defects do not establish new errors in the paper or retract its existing findings.

repairProposal.operation: Insert With notation as above, after Proposition 4.4.2. in the final quoted segment, and update the matching batch quotation. Do not change the determinant or pairing data or apply the existing mathematical correction.

The first published fragment uses ψ̄, consistently with the character introduced earlier in that hypothesis; the stored quotation uses ψ. The second quotation matches. Both passages really say irreducible, not absolutely irreducible.
findings.verdict: Both irreducibility requirements occur in the published paper. The missing overbar is an input-transcription discrepancy, not an established publication change. Leave the current quotation’s outcome unresolved rather than declaring the finding preprint-only, absent or literally identical.

repairProposal.operation: Add the overbar to ψ in the first quotation and update the batch copy. Keep irreducible in both quotations: replacing it by absolutely irreducible would insert the proposed mathematical correction into the quoted source.
repairProposal.afterRepair: After this one-symbol transcription repair, both quoted fragments match the published text inspected here.

findings.evidence: Page image of Proposition 6.2.3(7) on p. 55: the full quoted sentence, including its numbering, matches. The later hypotheses (8)–(17) and proof on pp. 55–56 were read for context.
